notes: Two owner directions in one stroke. First: *"we aren't seeing what the sectors are incrementally adding as new dependencies, which ones are increments to existing ones that are inherited, and which ones are overrides."* Every resolved dependency row now carries its lineage (the whole chain of layers that touched it) and a vs inherited classification rendered as its own grid column: *baseline (common)*, *+ added by <layer>*, *↺ from → to (Δ, was <layer>)* — and removals are tombstones, struck-through rows showing what was removed, by whom, and what it displaced — never a silent absence.
